checks.name: apply and reapply all three migrations, preserving balances, legacy rights and unrelated app
all gates are false; referral and quota RPCs cannot mutate when disabled
anon/authenticated denied direct tables, ownership changes and RPCs even with forged claims
referral attribution: signed-code contract, no self/old accounts/re-attribution
only verified first 90% meditation qualifies; reward pair is atomic and duplicate-safe
referral monthly cap limits the sixth pair without deleting legitimate rewards
quota reserve concurrency: at most ten free successful/in-flight responses per calendar month
settlement requires owner-matching successful provider usage and is idempotent
Lifetime is never silently downgraded; included paid-period allowances are distinct
birth data/calculation/report owners are enforced by composite foreign keys; edit invalidates derivatives
verified self birth reuses My Universe; raw edits invalidate only its chart and keep other private profiles
privacy erase deletes all birth profiles and derivatives even with astrology off; unrelated owner preserved
stale calculation revision and birth profile limit cannot be bypassed by service callers
AI reports serialize duplicate claims, share legacy allowance, cache once and reject foreign charts
commercial sales OFF, server prices, accepted receipt and exact-once Seeds/refunds
subscription renewal/cancel/expire/refund keeps existing Lifetime and fixed-term rights
safe feature-off rollback preserves audit records, earned balances and the other application

caveats: PGlite serializes connection access; native multi-connection lock stress is still required before production activation.
Feature-off rollback intentionally retains private records and valid ledger entries.
